name: Nuvemshop
description: Connect your Nuvemshop / Tiendanube store so the agent can find a customer's orders, track shipments, cancel or re-route undispatched orders, record refund requests, send payment links for unpaid orders, give capped goodwill coupons and answer product and stock questions.

nuvemshop_get_store.label: Get Store Info
nuvemshop_get_store.description: Get basic store information: name, URL, country, languages and currency.

nuvemshop_find_customer.label: Find Customer
nuvemshop_find_customer.description: Find a customer by email or CPF/CNPJ/DNI (accounts and guest orders), with their most recent orders.

nuvemshop_get_customer.label: Get Customer
nuvemshop_get_customer.description: Get a customer's contact details, addresses and total spent by id.

nuvemshop_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
nuvemshop_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders by email, most recent first.

nuvemshop_get_order.label: Get Order
nuvemshop_get_order.description: Get an order by id or number: items, totals, payment and Pix status, tracking and support eligibility.

nuvemshop_get_order_tracking.label: Get Order Tracking
nuvemshop_get_order_tracking.description: Get an order's tracking number, link, carrier, delivery window and latest carrier event.

nuvemshop_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
nuvemshop_cancel_order.description: Cancel an order that has not been dispatched. Does not move money.

nuvemshop_update_order_shipping_address.label: Update Order Shipping Address
nuvemshop_update_order_shipping_address.description: Change where an undispatched order will be delivered. Refuses once a label or tracking exists.

nuvemshop_add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
nuvemshop_add_order_note.description: Append an internal note to an order as an audit trail. Earlier notes are kept.

nuvemshop_check_refund_status.label: Check Refund Status
nuvemshop_check_refund_status.description: Check an order's refund state, payment provider and refund dates, and how a refund is executed.

nuvemshop_request_refund.label: Request Refund
nuvemshop_request_refund.description: Record a capped refund request on a paid order for the merchant. The API cannot move money.

nuvemshop_get_payment_link.label: Get Payment Link
nuvemshop_get_payment_link.description: Get an unpaid order's Pix code, boleto or payment link once the shopper's email or phone matches.

nuvemshop_create_coupon.label: Create Goodwill Coupon
nuvemshop_create_coupon.description: Create a single-use apology coupon within the merchant's percentage or amount cap.

nuvemshop_search_products.label: Search Products
nuvemshop_search_products.description: Search published products by name, description or SKU.

nuvemshop_get_product.label: Get Product
nuvemshop_get_product.description: Get a product with description, variants, prices and stock.

nuvemshop_check_inventory.label: Check Inventory
nuvemshop_check_inventory.description: Check stock and price for a variant SKU.

nuvemshop_get_return_instructions.label: Get Return Instructions
nuvemshop_get_return_instructions.description: Get the store's own instructions for returning an item, to relay as written.

authMode.label: Connection mode
authMode.description: Connect with Nuvemshop: approve Hay.chat in your store in one click. Custom app token: paste a token from a custom app you created.

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Set by the Hay.chat server. Leave empty.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Set by the Hay.chat server. Leave empty.

storeId.label: Store ID
storeId.description: Your numeric store ID (the store's user_id, shown when creating the custom app).

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.description: Access token from a custom app (admin → Custom apps). Grant read/write orders, fulfillment orders, customers and coupons, and read products. Shown only once.

couponsEnabled.label: Allow goodwill coupons
couponsEnabled.description: Let the agent create single-use apology coupons within the caps below. A coupon above the cap waits for a team member to approve it. Each order gets at most one coupon.

couponMaxPercent.label: Coupon cap: maximum percentage
couponMaxPercent.description: Largest percentage discount the agent may give (0 turns percentage coupons off).

couponMaxAmount.label: Coupon cap: maximum fixed amount
couponMaxAmount.description: Largest fixed discount in your store currency (0 or empty turns fixed-amount coupons off).

couponMaxDays.label: Coupon validity (days)
couponMaxDays.description: Coupons the agent creates expire after at most this many days.

staleTrackingDomesticDays.label: Stale tracking: domestic (days)
staleTrackingDomesticDays.description: Treat a domestic shipment as stuck when its tracking has not moved for more than this many days.

staleTrackingInternationalDays.label: Stale tracking: international (days)
staleTrackingInternationalDays.description: Treat an international shipment as stuck when its tracking has not moved for more than this many days.

returnInstructions.label: How to return
returnInstructions.description: Your return process, in your words: where to send items, any link or form, and deadlines. Hay.chat relays it as written when a customer asks how to return something. Leave empty and Hay.chat hands those questions to your team.
